name: Mori Hime
storyline:
Mori hime is a short visual novel RPG that follows Mori, a hikikomori who doesn’t leave her apartment, and Hime, her magical girl OC who pops out of her screen one day and convinces her to travel across realms…

Mori, A Rotten Girl:
Known for her distinct black fluffy hair and reclusive lifestyle, Mori is a shy, loving part-time artist, full-time gamer who has too many goals but too little confidence! One of her main goals in life is to make a friend but with all the stuff going on in the world right now and her fear of stepping out into the big scary world, it makes her goal quite the struggle to achieve…

Hime, An Angel Reincarnated :
A magical girl with a love for all things cute and pink - Hime descends from her parallel dimensional realm to carry very very important messages to Mori.. like saving the world and having a good time!
summary:
Mori hime is a short visual novel RPG made by Ryu aka 9ryuq that follows Mori, a hikikomori who doesn’t leave her apartment, and Hime, her magical girl OC who pops out of her screen one day and convinces her to travel across realms… Mori hime is a magical girl cyber-morute RPG where you fight inter-dimensional evil, save the world, and (most importantly) be cute!

Consisting of two main endings and one secret ending with ~30 minutes of game time, you too can travel across realms and save the world from catastrophic evil for (approximately) half an hour ! The fate of the world is in your hands
